profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I have lived in Portland my whole life. I grew up playing sports all the way through high school. If you had told me in high school I would earn a degree in computer science I probably would have laughed at you.  After high school I was unsure of my higher education goals and worked for a little over a year until I decided I wanted to go back to school.  I have was having trouble finding an area of study which engaged and excited me.  At the request of my Mother (who is a retired software engineer) I took a computer science class and instantly fell in love. Ever since than I have been trying achieving my degree in computer science from Portland State University (PSU). This last summer I accomplished this goal and graduated from PSU with my degree. In November, I was re-hired by the Nike Company Store doing my old job as a point of sales associate. After working at Nike I am now ready to enter to workforce in a career which uses my degree. I am a highly motivated, personable individual with the skill set which allows me to learn quickly in a high tech environment. Using my communication skills I can be a productive team member even in high pressure situations.

positions.title: Point of sales associate
positions.description: I work in the stock room and on the sales floor restocking the sales inventory.  I use team work with my fellow associates to make sure the floor was stocked at all times.  I communicate with my fellow associates to make sure we were not stocking the same sections on the floor.  Making sure to Prioritize my time to make sure the better selling or empty sections always got filled first.  I would use goal setting to accomplish daily tasks such as taking down and setting up displays or keeping displays fully stocked.
